purpose: Modal-backed confirmation prompt with cancel and confirm actions, including a destructive variant for irreversible operations.
useWhen: Requiring an explicit yes/no acknowledgement before performing a destructive or irreversible action.
Asking the user to confirm a discrete decision with two clear outcomes.

avoidWhen.reason: Collecting a long form of many fields or sections — compose a modal with form controls instead. One or two labelled controls that change what the confirmation does belong in options.
Announcing a non-blocking result — use toast-region or banner.
